name: Corners Are Exactly Unique Facet Traces
statement: Let $H\subseteq Q_F$ be ample with shattered complex $\Sigma$. A concept $x\in H$ is a corner exactly when some facet $T$ of $\Sigma$ has trace $x|_T$ realized by no other member of $H$.
proof: Deleting $x$ loses a shattered face precisely when its trace there was unique. The Sandwich inequalities and the ample corner-deletion criterion say that deletion is ample exactly when it loses one shattered face. Uniqueness propagates from a face to every shattered coface, so exactly one face is lost precisely when that face is a facet.
